name: jev-plan-review
description: Checks a plan against what you said while it was prepared, using TypeSafe's Jev model.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: typesafe or openrouter: where Jev requests are sent

min_confidence.title: Confidence threshold (%)
min_confidence.description: 50 to 100: answers below this are marked unsure and are never sent back to Claude

auto_review.title: Review plan-mode plans automatically
auto_review.description: on or off: review every plan-mode plan before it is shown

max_revisions.title: Times one plan may be sent back
max_revisions.description: 1 or more: how many times one plan may be sent back

max_statements.title: Statements one review may check
max_statements.description: 1 or more: how many statements one review may check

show_inconclusive.title: Show items Jev was unsure of
show_inconclusive.description: on or off: show items Jev was unsure of

reverse_plan_check.title: List what the plan decided that you never said
reverse_plan_check.description: on or off: in the command, also list what the plan decided that the user never said
